findings.scan_cap_note_verbatim: NOTE: the award scan hit its page cap for at least one niche -- distinct-firm counts are bounded by the scan, not the market, so treat them as a floor.
findings.inert_weight: price_band (20 pts) is identical at 20.0/20 for all 8 niches and repeat_bidders (15 pts) is at its 15.0/15 max for 6 of 8. 35 of 100 weighted points do no discriminating work.
findings.dominant_term: notice_flow supplies 30.0/43.3 = 69% of all realized spread, set_aside the remaining bulk. The ranking is therefore mostly a 30-day SAM notice count -- one count-only request per niche, a seasonal snapshot, not a trend.
findings.scan_cap_scope: scan_capped is true for ALL EIGHT niches, not just one: sample_size is 485-497 against a ~500 cap. Every distinct_sb_awardees figure is a floor, so awards_per_firm (and the repeat_bidders term derived from it) and the prospect gate all rest on a truncated sample.

gate_shortlist_contradiction.summary: The SHORTLIST line recommends 541519 as the lead pick, but 541519 FAILS the prospect gate (119 distinct small-business awardees found vs GATE_MIN_PROSPECTS=150).
gate_shortlist_contradiction.cause: niche_scorer.py:206 filters the shortlist only on the 'control' label, not on prospects_gate, so a gate failure cannot keep a niche out of the recommendation.
gate_shortlist_contradiction.mitigating: Because the scan is capped, 119 is a floor -- the true awardee count may clear 150. The FAIL is unproven rather than disproven. Gate PASSES are sound (floor already exceeds the threshold); gate FAILS are not.
gate_shortlist_contradiction.practical_effect: The scorer's own advice for a 9.2-point gap is a 75/75 split, and 75 sends is survivable even at the 119 floor. Leading with 541519 alone at the full 150-send volume is what the gate has not cleared.

findings.metric_definition_change: set_aside_share in this run (competition set aside for small business, 3.8%-35%) is a different and stricter quantity than the small-business-recipient share probed in the previous run (21.9%-67.5%). The two are not comparable; the drop is definitional, not a regression.

founder_action_needed: Do not treat this ranking as a final pick. It is decision-grade enough to narrow, not to commit: 35% of the composite weight is inert, the ranking is driven mainly by a single 30-day notice count, and the top-ranked niche (541519) has not cleared its prospect gate. The niche pick stays with the founder; state/niche.json was not written by this run.
